JO.title: Nutella Brownies ✨🧸🍫 Brownie Layer: 110g butter (½ cup) 170g chocolate (1 cup) 200g sugar (1 cup) 2 eggs 80g flour (⅔ cup) 20g cocoa powder (3 tbsp) 1 tsp vanilla 45g chocolate chunks (¼ cup) ½ tsp salt Nutella (about 4–5 tbsp) Extra chocolate chunks Instructions: Melt the butter and chocolate together until smooth. Mix in the sugar, then add the eggs and vanilla. Fold in the flour, cocoa powder, and salt until combined, then mix in the chocolate chunks. Pour half of the brownie batter into a lined baking pan and spread evenly. Add spoonfuls of Nutella in the middle, then cover with the remaining brownie batter. Top with extra chocolate chunks and bake at 175°C until the top is crackly and the center stays fudgy. Enjoy✨ #brownie #baking #chocolate #nutella #recipes

Pour half of the brownie batter into a lined baking pan and spread evenly. Add spoonfuls of Nutella in the middle, then cover with the remaining brownie batter.
